report.title: Alphabet FY2025初始公司研究报告：AI让公司更强，也让商业模式的重估更复杂。

thesis.text: 我的初始判断是：Alphabet依然是优质现金创造者，但投资逻辑已经从“搜索广告的高确定性复利”转向“AI时代的平台再定价”。短期看，广告仍是主引擎，云在改善，Other Bets不重要；中期看，决定估值中枢的不是收入是否增长，而是AI是否既能保住搜索与广告效率，又能把更多算力和产品能力转化为可持续的企业收入。

citations.quote: Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets. Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. Alphabet's structure is about helping each of our businesses prosper through strong leaders and independence.

Expanded AI Offerings in our Products and Services: The continuing evolution of the online world has contributed to the growth of our business. We expect that this evolution, including user engagement with AI products and services, will continue to benefit our business and our revenues. As we continue to incorporate AI into our products and services, such as with AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search, and with enterprise AI solutions on our Google Cloud Platform, we may monetize differently than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings which could affect revenue growth rates and margin trends. When developing new products and services we generally focus first on user experience and then on monetization. At the same time, we face increasing competition, including from other developers and providers of AI products and services, which may affect our revenues.

Increased Investment in Technical Infrastructure: We continue to invest in capital expenditures as we scale our technical infrastructure, in particular for AI, to meet the demand of our users and enterprise customers and to support research internally. We invested heavily in capital expenditures in 2025 and in 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment, and data centers. The costs associated with operating our technical infrastructure - depreciation, energy, equipment, and network capacity - are expected to significantly increase as developing and serving AI offerings require more compute power than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings. While our technical infrastructure costs increase, we expect to continue to drive efficiencies in our data centers, for example, through the design of our AI models and our TPU and GPU-based technical infrastructure.

sections.title: 核心判断：Alphabet仍是强现金流平台公司，但2025年以后它的估值核心不再只是广告稳态，而是AI投入能否在不显著稀释利润率的前提下，继续转化为搜索、云和订阅的可持续变现。

paragraphs.text: Alphabet的业务不是单一产品，而是以Google为核心的业务集合：Google Services、Google Cloud和Other Bets。公司还把部分AI相关研究与前沿模型开发放在Alphabet层面。它对自身的定义更像一个围绕信息组织、分发、计算和AI能力的平台组合，而不是单一广告公司。

citations.quote: As our founders Larry and Sergey wrote in the original founders' letter, "Google is not a conventional company. We do not intend to become one." That unconventional spirit has been a driving force throughout our history, inspiring us to tackle big problems and invest in moonshots. It led us to be a pioneer in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and, since 2016, be an AI-first company. We continue this work under the leadership of Alphabet and Google CEO, Sundar Pichai.

Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. sections.title: 行业不是在原地扩容，而是在AI推动下重新洗牌；Alphabet仍强，但护城河需要持续投入才能维持。

paragraphs.text: Alphabet把自身最核心的行业风险写得很直接：公司超过70%的2025年总收入来自在线广告；广告支出受宏观环境影响，广告主和合作伙伴可随时终止合作，隐私政策变化、广告拦截技术以及影响个性化投放的技术都可能损害变现。也就是说，Alphabet并不是只要流量大就天然安全，广告效率和合作生态才是利润根基。

citations.quote: We generate a significant portion of our revenues from advertising. Reduced spending by advertisers, a loss of partners, shifts in online advertising, new and evolving advertising formats, or new or existing technologies that block ads online or affect our ability to personalize ads could harm our business.

We generated more than 70% of total revenues from online advertising in 2025. Many of our advertisers, companies that distribute our products and services, digital publishers, and content providers can terminate their contracts with us at any time. These partners may not continue to do business with us if we do not create more value (such as increased numbers of users or customers, new sales leads, increased brand awareness, or more effective monetization) than their available alternatives.

Changes to our advertising policies and data privacy practices, as well as changes to other companies' advertising or data privacy practices have in the past, and may in the future, affect the advertising services that we are able to provide. In addition, technologies have been developed that make personalized ads more difficult, or that block the display of ads altogether, and some providers of online services have integrated technologies that could impair the availability and functionality of third-party digital advertising. Failing to provide superior value or deliver advertisements effectively and competitively could harm our business, reputation, financial condition, and operating results.

Expenditures by advertisers tend to correlate with overall economic conditions. Adverse macroeconomic conditions have affected, and may in the future affect, the demand for advertising, resulting in fluctuations in the amounts our advertisers spend on advertising, which could harm our financial condition and operating results.

paragraphs.text: 公司同时明确，AI正在重塑广告行业，且它与竞争对手都在快速适应新的广告格式和交付方式；在MD&A中，公司还提到AI Overviews、AI Mode和企业AI解决方案可能带来不同于历史路径的变现方式，并面临来自其他AI开发者和供应商的竞争。

citations.quote: We believe AI is quickly reshaping the advertising industry, including how ads are delivered online, and we and our competitors are constantly adjusting to meet this shift and provide new and evolving advertising formats. There is no assurance that we will adapt effectively and competitively to meet this shift, and that such advertising formats, strategies, and offerings will be successful.

Expanded AI Offerings in our Products and Services: The continuing evolution of the online world has contributed to the growth of our business. We expect that this evolution, including user engagement with AI products and services, will continue to benefit our business and our revenues. As we continue to incorporate AI into our products and services, such as with AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search, and with enterprise AI solutions on our Google Cloud Platform, we may monetize differently than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings which could affect revenue growth rates and margin trends. When developing new products and services we generally focus first on user experience and then on monetization. At the same time, we face increasing competition, including from other developers and providers of AI products and services, which may affect our revenues.

paragraphs.text: 因此，Alphabet面对的不是传统搜索广告的静态竞争，而是AI时代的再定价。搜索和广告的护城河仍在，但竞争焦点已经从“谁有流量”变成“谁能把AI体验、广告格式、云算力和企业服务更有效地打包”。同时，大量租赁安排和长周期合同会提高运营复杂性，也让供需错配与履约风险更值得关注。

citations.quote: Increasing Revenues Beyond Advertising: Revenues from cloud, consumer subscriptions, platforms, and devices, which may have differing characteristics than our advertising revenues, have grown over time. Certain of these revenues have been growing at a rate higher than our advertising revenues, becoming a larger percentage of our consolidated revenues, and we expect this trend to continue. The margins on these revenues vary significantly and are generally lower than the margins on our advertising revenues.

Increased Investment in Technical Infrastructure: We continue to invest in capital expenditures as we scale our technical infrastructure, in particular for AI, to meet the demand of our users and enterprise customers and to support research internally. We invested heavily in capital expenditures in 2025 and in 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment, and data centers. The costs associated with operating our technical infrastructure - depreciation, energy, equipment, and network capacity - are expected to significantly increase as developing and serving AI offerings require more compute power than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings. While our technical infrastructure costs increase, we expect to continue to drive efficiencies in our data centers, for example, through the design of our AI models and our TPU and GPU-based technical infrastructure.

To meet the compute capacity demands of AI training and inference, as well as traditional cloud computing services, we are entering into significant leasing arrangements with third party operators, which may increase costs and operational complexity. We also have a number of large, long-duration commercial agreements, which could increase our liabilities and obligations in the event of nonperformance by us, our counterparties, or vendors. In such nonperformance or an industry downturn, we may incur additional liabilities, have excess capacity that we cannot easily redeploy, and not receive payments from our counterparties or customers.

sections.title: 赚钱能力强，但结构正在变化；真正的问题是AI驱动的收入增量，能否抵消更快上升的资本开支和低毛利业务占比。

paragraphs.text: 从三年数据看，Alphabet的增长来自多个层面：总收入由2023年的3073.94亿美元升至2024年的3500.18亿美元，再到2025年的4028.36亿美元；营业利润由842.93亿美元升至1123.90亿美元，再到1290.39亿美元。Google Cloud营业利润从2023年的17.16亿美元提高到2025年的139.10亿美元，说明云业务已从早期亏损阶段明显走向盈利贡献。

We have invested and expect to significantly expand our investment in property and equipment, including our technical infrastructure, and we expect these assets to benefit our business over their estimated useful lives. Changes in facts and circumstances such as changes to historical asset performance, expected technology advancements, and future network deployment plans could change the period over which we expect to benefit from the asset and impact our financial condition and operating results.

sections.title: 价格是否合适：无法基于当前材料判断，但可确认估值敏感点集中在利润质量、AI资本开支和非经营性投资收益的可持续性。

paragraphs.text: 仅根据这份10-K，不能判断Alphabet当前价格是否合适。材料里没有截至2026-02-05的股价、流通股口径下的市值、可比公司估值或明确的前瞻盈利假设，因此无法建立可验证的估值框架，也不应编造目标价。
不过，财务质量至少不弱：审计意见对2024与2025年合并报表给出无保留意见；同时，公司在2026年1月确认约320亿美元未实现收益，来自非市场化投资在可观察交易后的公允价值重估。这提示Alphabet账上确实有较大规模的非经营性资产价值弹性，但这类收益波动性高，不能直接当作经营利润的一部分去估值。

before.title: Alphabet FY2025初始公司研究报告：AI让公司更强，也让商业模式的重估更复杂。

thesis.text: 我的初始判断是：Alphabet依然是优质现金创造者，但投资逻辑已经从“搜索广告的高确定性复利”转向“AI时代的平台再定价”。短期看，广告仍是主引擎，云在改善，Other Bets不重要；中期看，决定估值中枢的不是收入是否增长，而是AI是否既能保住搜索与广告效率，又能把更多算力和产品能力转化为可持续的企业收入。

citations.quote: Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets. Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. Alphabet's structure is about helping each of our businesses prosper through strong leaders and independence.

We believe AI is quickly reshaping the advertising industry, including how ads are delivered online, and we and our competitors are constantly adjusting to meet this shift and provide new and evolving advertising formats. There is no assurance that we will adapt effectively and competitively to meet this shift, and that such advertising formats, strategies, and offerings will be successful.

Increased Investment in Technical Infrastructure: We continue to invest in capital expenditures as we scale our technical infrastructure, in particular for AI, to meet the demand of our users and enterprise customers and to support research internally. We invested heavily in capital expenditures in 2025 and in 2026, we expect to significantly increase, relative to 2025, our investment in our technical infrastructure, including servers and network equipment, and data centers. The costs associated with operating our technical infrastructure - depreciation, energy, equipment, and network capacity - are expected to significantly increase as developing and serving AI offerings require more compute power than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings. While our technical infrastructure costs increase, we expect to continue to drive efficiencies in our data centers, for example, through the design of our AI models and our TPU and GPU-based technical infrastructure.

sections.title: 核心判断：Alphabet仍是一家以广告为主、云和AI在加速但尚未取代核心现金牛的平台公司，未来3–5年的关键不在“有没有增长”，而在AI能否在不明显侵蚀搜索变现与利润率的前提下，继续抬升流量、广告形式和云业务规模。

paragraphs.text: Alphabet的业务不是单一产品，而是以Google为核心的业务集合：Google Services、Google Cloud和Other Bets。公司把AI相关基础研究和前沿模型开发放在Alphabet层面，并明确将AI基础设施视为支撑Search、YouTube和Cloud的关键能力。业务层面的官方叙述说明，其生意本质仍是围绕信息获取、广告、云服务和AI能力的平台型分发。

citations.quote: Alphabet is a collection of businesses — the largest of which is Google. We report Google in two segments, Google Services and Google Cloud, and all non-Google businesses collectively as Other Bets. Supporting these businesses, we have centralized certain AI-related research and development focused on advanced research in AI and developing the frontier models that serve our businesses, which is reported in Alphabet-level activities. Alphabet's structure is about helping each of our businesses prosper through strong leaders and independence.

We are focused on building an even more helpful Google for everyone, and we aspire to give everyone the tools they need to increase their knowledge, health, happiness, and success. Google Search helps people find information and make sense of the world in more natural and intuitive ways, with trillions of searches on Google every year. YouTube provides people with entertainment, information, and opportunities to learn something new and helps support the creator economy through the YouTube Partner Program. Google Cloud helps customers build for the future, improve productivity, reduce costs, and unlock new growth engines. We continually innovate and build new products and features to help our users, partners, customers, and communities and have invested more than $200 billion in research and development in the last five years in support of these efforts.

We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. We aim to build the most advanced, safe, and responsible AI through our full-stack approach, which spans AI-optimized infrastructure; world-class research, including models and tooling; and our products and platforms that bring AI to billions of people, developers, and enterprises.

At the foundation of our full-stack approach is our AI-optimized infrastructure — a key differentiator enabling us to power our own products, such as Search and YouTube, and support the services we provide to our Google Cloud customers. Our technical infrastructure allows us to use and offer our customers a range of AI accelerator options, including specialized Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and our own custom-built Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), such as Ironwood, our seventh-generation TPU. We are focused on driving efficiencies in our data centers, allowing us to leverage our technical infrastructure to deliver our products and services at an increasing scale while simultaneously enabling world-class research and model development.

sections.title: 行业的本质变化是AI在重写搜索、广告和云的竞争边界，Alphabet的护城河仍在，但不再是“天然稳固”的那种。

paragraphs.text: Alphabet自己把竞争压力的核心写在广告上：公司超过70%的2025年总收入来自在线广告，广告支出会受宏观环境影响，且广告技术、隐私政策变化以及拦截广告的技术都可能削弱其变现能力。公司同时强调，广告主和渠道伙伴可以随时终止合作，因此它并不是单纯依赖“流量大”就能稳态赚钱，仍要持续提供优于替代方案的转化效率。

citations.quote: We generate a significant portion of our revenues from advertising. Reduced spending by advertisers, a loss of partners, shifts in online advertising, new and evolving advertising formats, or new or existing technologies that block ads online or affect our ability to personalize ads could harm our business.

We generated more than 70% of total revenues from online advertising in 2025. Many of our advertisers, companies that distribute our products and services, digital publishers, and content providers can terminate their contracts with us at any time. These partners may not continue to do business with us if we do not create more value (such as increased numbers of users or customers, new sales leads, increased brand awareness, or more effective monetization) than their available alternatives.

Changes to our advertising policies and data privacy practices, as well as changes to other companies' advertising or data privacy practices have in the past, and may in the future, affect the advertising services that we are able to provide. In addition, technologies have been developed that make personalized ads more difficult, or that block the display of ads altogether, and some providers of online services have integrated technologies that could impair the availability and functionality of third-party digital advertising. Failing to provide superior value or deliver advertisements effectively and competitively could harm our business, reputation, financial condition, and operating results.

Expenditures by advertisers tend to correlate with overall economic conditions. Adverse macroeconomic conditions have affected, and may in the future affect, the demand for advertising, resulting in fluctuations in the amounts our advertisers spend on advertising, which could harm our financial condition and operating results.

paragraphs.text: 更重要的是，AI正在重塑搜索和广告行业的竞争规则。Alphabet承认需要与其他AI产品和服务提供商竞争，并且新AI产品可能改变广告交付和变现方式。这说明它面对的不是传统搜索的静态竞争，而是一个规则仍在变化的市场：谁能在不损害用户体验的情况下把AI结果和广告更好地结合，谁就更可能守住份额和单位变现。

citations.quote: We believe AI is quickly reshaping the advertising industry, including how ads are delivered online, and we and our competitors are constantly adjusting to meet this shift and provide new and evolving advertising formats. There is no assurance that we will adapt effectively and competitively to meet this shift, and that such advertising formats, strategies, and offerings will be successful.

Expanded AI Offerings in our Products and Services: The continuing evolution of the online world has contributed to the growth of our business. We expect that this evolution, including user engagement with AI products and services, will continue to benefit our business and our revenues. As we continue to incorporate AI into our products and services, such as with AI Overviews and AI Mode in Search, and with enterprise AI solutions on our Google Cloud Platform, we may monetize differently than our historical consumer and enterprise offerings which could affect revenue growth rates and margin trends. When developing new products and services we generally focus first on user experience and then on monetization. At the same time, we face increasing competition, including from other developers and providers of AI products and services, which may affect our revenues.

paragraphs.text: 云业务的竞争逻辑与广告不同，它更看重基础设施、产品深度和长期客户关系，但其毛利通常低于广告，因此如果云收入占比继续提高，即使总营收更快，集团层面的利润率未必同步抬升。与此同时，为满足AI训练和推理的算力需求，公司进入大量第三方租赁安排和长周期商业协议，这会提高运营复杂性，也让供需错配或履约风险更值得关注。

citations.quote: Increasing Revenues Beyond Advertising: Revenues from cloud, consumer subscriptions, platforms, and devices, which may have differing characteristics than our advertising revenues, have grown over time. Certain of these revenues have been growing at a rate higher than our advertising revenues, becoming a larger percentage of our consolidated revenues, and we expect this trend to continue. The margins on these revenues vary significantly and are generally lower than the margins on our advertising revenues.

To meet the compute capacity demands of AI training and inference, as well as traditional cloud computing services, we are entering into significant leasing arrangements with third party operators, which may increase costs and operational complexity. We also have a number of large, long-duration commercial agreements, which could increase our liabilities and obligations in the event of nonperformance by us, our counterparties, or vendors. In such nonperformance or an industry downturn, we may incur additional liabilities, have excess capacity that we cannot easily redeploy, and not receive payments from our counterparties or customers.

sections.title: 价格是否合适：无法基于当前材料判断，但可确认估值敏感点集中在利润质量、AI资本开支和非经营性投资收益的可持续性。

paragraphs.text: 仅根据这份10-K，不能判断Alphabet当前价格是否合适。原因很简单：材料里没有截至2026-02-05的股价、流通股口径下的市值、可比公司估值或明确的前瞻盈利假设，因此无法建立可验证的估值框架，也不应编造目标价。
不过，财务质量至少不弱：审计意见对2024与2025年合并报表给出无保留意见；同时，公司在2026年1月确认约320亿美元未实现收益，来自非市场化投资在可观察交易后的公允价值重估。这提示Alphabet账上确实有较大规模的非经营性资产价值弹性，但这类收益波动性高，不能直接当作经营利润的一部分去估值。

Reduced spending by advertisers, a loss of partners, shifts in online advertising, new and evolving advertising formats, or new or existing technologies that block ads online or affect our ability to personalize ads could harm our business.

Changes to our advertising policies and data privacy practices, as well as changes to other companies' advertising or data privacy practices have in the past, and may in the future, affect the advertising services that we are able to provide. In addition, technologies have been developed that make personalized ads more difficult, or that block the display of ads altogether, and some providers of online services have integrated technologies that could impair the availability and functionality of third-party digital advertising. Failing to provide superior value or deliver advertisements effectively and competitively could harm our business, reputation, financial condition, and operating results.

To meet the compute capacity demands of AI training and inference, as well as traditional cloud computing services, we are entering into significant leasing arrangements with third party operators, which may increase costs and operational complexity. We also have a number of large, long-duration commercial agreements, which could increase our liabilities and obligations in the event of nonperformance by us, our counterparties, or vendors. In such nonperformance or an industry downturn, we may incur additional liabilities, have excess capacity that we cannot easily redeploy, and not receive payments from our counterparties or customers.

paragraphs.text: 另外，非市场化投资的公允价值重估可能继续带来较大波动，但它更像资产价值的会计反映，不应被当成可重复经营收益。是否能持续兑现，取决于相关投资的后续交易与退出，而这在当前材料中不可验证。

citations.quote: In January 2026, we recognized approximately $32.0 billion of unrealized gains in our non-marketable investments. These unrealized gains reflect an estimated increase in the fair value measurement following observable transactions that occurred in January 2026, and are subject to change as we finalize related valuations. See Note 3 and Note 7 for further details on equity investments and OI&E.
